title: Notion UI — page editor · database · sidebar primitives
description: The pure, props-driven Notion-clone primitives suite behind one slug, over one shared domain-type model (Block / Page / Property / Database / DbView …). Three surface variants: page — the page + block editor (NotionPage / NotionHeader / NotionBlock, SlashMenu, block renderers, inline-markdown decorator); database — a drop-in 11-view database (table/board/list/gallery/calendar/feed/chart/dashboard/form/map/timeline, 18 property types, filter/sort/group/calculate, formula engine, CSV/JSON I/O); sidebar — a standalone tree-nav sidebar (dnd reorder + reparent, inline rename). All stateless and callback-CRUD (host owns data, no store, no Convex). Install one surface with `npx rr add notion-ui page|database|sidebar`, or all with `npx rr add notion-ui`. The shared/ domain type model is copied for every variant. NOT the full Notion app — that's the separate `notion` slice (adapter + Convex backed).
